reason: A workflow orchestration plugin for DSH that routes GitHub engineering tasks, coordinates review and CI workflows, and supports approval-gated publishing rather than providing GitHub API tools itself.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH 提供 GitHub 工程任务的智能路由与工作流编排，涵盖代码审查反馈、CI 诊断和经审批的变更发布。
summaries.en: Provides DSH with GitHub workflow routing and orchestration for review feedback, CI diagnosis, and approval-gated publishing of local changes.

capabilities: Routes GitHub and Git workflow tasks among specialized skills
Analyzes pull request review feedback and may apply related local fixes
Diagnoses or fixes GitHub Actions issues using check and log evidence
Stages, commits, pushes local changes, and may create Draft pull requests with explicit intent or approval
